scene.note: The fares and tickets live in one package and the hut in another, so the hut can make tickets but never work out a fare itself.

steps.note: The fares file starts by naming its package, which follows its folders.
The ticket code, in the same package, may ask for a fare by age.
The hut, in another package, cannot reach the fares at all.
A ticket is made from a passenger and an age, in the tickets package.
Its fare comes from the fares file, the one place the rule lives.
The hut, in another package, can make a ticket and ask for its line, and nothing more.
The morning queue comes into the hut's program, in order.
The hut brings in the ticket class from its package and makes one ticket per person.
All the files are built together into one folder, and the hut is run by its full name.
